title: Terraform / TFE
headline: Terraform expresses infrastructure as versioned, reviewable configuration.
rules: Protect state and restrict access; use locking for shared state.
Review plans and promote changes through controlled environments.
failures: State drift or concurrent operations can cause unexpected plans.
Overly broad provider credentials increase blast radius.
snippet:
terraform init
terraform plan
terraform apply

flashcards.question: Why review a Terraform plan?
flashcards.answer: To inspect intended changes before applying them.

title: Azure Landing Zones
headline: Azure landing zones establish a governed foundation for workloads.
rules: Design management groups, identity, network and policy together.
Apply guardrails consistently and review exceptions.
failures: Missing network routes or DNS can prevent workload connectivity.
Misapplied policies can block deployments.
snippet:
az account show
az policy assignment list

flashcards.question: What is a landing zone?
flashcards.answer: A governed Azure environment prepared for workloads.

title: Microsoft Fabric
headline: Microsoft Fabric integrates analytics workloads around a shared data platform.
rules: Separate environments and establish governed deployment practices.
Monitor capacity and apply identity and data governance controls.
failures: Capacity contention can slow workloads.
Incorrect workspace or data permissions can block access.
snippet: # Review Fabric capacity metrics and workspace permissions.

flashcards.question: What should be checked when Fabric workloads slow down?
flashcards.answer: Capacity utilization, workload behavior and resource contention.

title: Kubernetes / AKS
headline: Kubernetes orchestrates container workloads using declarative resources.
rules: Use readiness and liveness probes suited to the application.
Set resource requests and limits and protect cluster access.
failures: Image pull errors prevent pods from starting.
Incorrect probes or resource limits can cause repeated restarts.
snippet:
kubectl get pods -A
kubectl describe pod <pod>

flashcards.question: What does a readiness probe control?
flashcards.answer: Whether a pod is ready to receive service traffic.

title: Prometheus / Grafana
headline: Metrics and dashboards help teams observe system health and trends.
rules: Choose actionable service indicators and alert thresholds.
Control metric cardinality and dashboard access.
failures: Missing scrape targets create monitoring blind spots.
High cardinality can increase storage and query costs.

title: CAF / WAF / NIST
headline: Architecture and security frameworks help structure governance decisions.
rules: Map controls to actual risks, ownership and evidence.
Review policy exceptions and compliance evidence regularly.
failures: Unowned exceptions undermine controls.
Control mappings without operational evidence can hide gaps.
snippet: # Document control, owner, evidence and exception.

flashcards.question: Why map a control to evidence?
flashcards.answer: To demonstrate and verify its operation.

title: IBM Turbonomic
headline: Turbonomic provides resource-management recommendations based on application demand.
rules: Validate recommendations against workload constraints and change controls.
Monitor cost and performance outcomes after changes.
failures: Unreviewed automation can conflict with workload requirements.
Incomplete discovery can reduce recommendation quality.
snippet: # Review recommendations, constraints and observed outcomes.

flashcards.question: What should be checked before acting on a sizing recommendation?
flashcards.answer: Workload constraints, risk and expected impact.

title: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
headline: CI/CD pipelines automate repeatable build, test and deployment steps.
rules: Use least-privilege identities and protect deployment environments.
Gate promotion with tests and reviews.
failures: Expired credentials can break deployment.
Missing environment approvals can permit unintended releases.
snippet:
# Example GitHub Actions step
- run: terraform plan

flashcards.question: Why gate production promotion?
flashcards.answer: To validate changes and require appropriate approval.

title: Docker
headline: Containers package applications and their dependencies into deployable images.
rules: Use trusted, maintained base images and minimize privileges.
Scan images and avoid embedding secrets.
failures: Missing environment configuration can prevent startup.
Incorrect image tags can deploy the wrong version.
snippet:
docker build -t example:local .
docker run --rm example:local

flashcards.question: Why avoid secrets in images?
flashcards.answer: Image layers can persist and expose embedded secrets.

title: PowerShell DSC
headline: PowerShell DSC describes and applies a desired configuration state.
rules: Version configuration and test changes before deployment.
Monitor configuration application and drift.
failures: Missing DSC resources can block configuration.
Configuration drift may reappear without monitoring.

flashcards.question: What is configuration drift?
flashcards.answer: A difference between the intended and actual configuration.
